affected_boundaries: planning selector to authenticated campaign dispatch

observed_behavior: A dependency-ready initial STUB sprint with no tasklets received no campaign dispatch despite an idle original campaign worker.
expected_behavior: The original idle worker can be assigned to author the selected sprint without receiving product implementation authority.
causal_mechanism: The campaign scheduler had dispatch predicates for runnable implementation tasklets and reviewed tasklet graphs but omitted the canonical initial planning selector.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Worker dispatch availability was inferred solely from downstream tasklet readiness states.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A valid planning-only sprint cannot have runnable tasklets until its graph is authored and reviewed, so it is never selected to start that work.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Each worker-owned lifecycle phase has a typed dispatch gated by its canonical phase selector and the same authenticated campaign provenance checks.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Expose the selected STUB sprint in the campaign graph and reserve an original idle campaign pair through PLAN_WORKER without altering implementation or review readiness.

applicability_conditions: No existing assignment for the plan
Safe original idle campaign session and worktree pair
known_non_matches: Aggregate plan without a STUB sprint
PLANNING or READY_FOR_REVIEW sprint without the initial planning selector
confirmation_evidence: GWEN integration-scaffolding-json-policy selected S01 via the canonical planning selector while previous schedule-ready and schedule-review-ready exposed no dispatch.
The focused planning dispatch regression and campaign report regression pass.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-census.test.js: campaign report and graph accept an initial planning-only sprint
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: initial planning uses an idle campaign pair while independent implementation retains its own pair
